conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Classify User Channel Message').item.json.phoneStatus === 'ok' || $('Classify User Channel Message').item.json.phoneStatus === 'bypass' }}

assignments.name: messageText

assignments.name: messageText

Please re-check the phone you typed. No action taken." }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Classify User Channel Message').item.json.expectedState === '*' || $('Load User Status').item.json.status === $('Classify User Channel Message').item.json.expectedState }}

assignments.name: messageText
assignments.value: ={{ $('Classify User Channel Message').item.json.kind === 'relay_text' ? ("⚠️ Message not relayed — customer is currently in `" + $('Load User Status').item.json.status + "`, expected `consultation_active`.
